# Meld Studio sub-actions

## Get current scene

Finds out which scene Meld Studio is showing and keeps it for later steps.

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%currentScene%` | The name of the live scene |
| `%currentSceneId%` | Meld's id for the live scene |

<small>Type id: `meldstudio.getCurrentScene`</small>

## Get scenes

Reads the names of all your Meld scenes and keeps them for later steps.

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%meldStudio.scenes%` | The list of scene names, as text |
| `%meldStudio.sceneCount%` | How many scenes there are |

<small>Type id: `meldstudio.getScenes`</small>

## Get status

Checks whether Meld Studio is connected, recording or streaming and keeps the answers for later steps.

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%meldStudio.isConnected%` | True if Cuebot is connected to Meld |
| `%meldStudio.isRecording%` | True if Meld is recording |
| `%meldStudio.isStreaming%` | True if Meld is streaming |

<small>Type id: `meldstudio.getStatus`</small>

## Media layer control

Plays, pauses or jumps within a video or sound layer in Meld Studio.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Scene** | The scene the layer is in, as Meld shows it. Leave empty to look in the live scene first, then in all scenes. |
| **Layer** | The media layer name as Meld shows it. |
| **Action** | Play, Pause, or Seek to jump to a time. Options: Play, Pause, Seek. Starts as: `Play`. |
| **Seek to (seconds)** | Only for Seek: the time to jump to, in seconds from the start. Starts as: `0`. |

<small>Type id: `meldstudio.mediaControl`</small>

## Record clip

Saves a short clip of the last moments in Meld Studio.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Length (seconds, 0-90)** | How many seconds to save, 1 to 90. Leave empty or 0 for the longest Meld can do. |

<small>Type id: `meldstudio.recordClip`</small>

## Recording

Starts or stops recording in Meld Studio.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **State** | Start begins recording, Stop ends it, Toggle does the opposite of what it is doing now. Options: Start, Stop, Toggle. Starts as: `Toggle`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%meldStudio.isRecording%` | True if Meld is recording afterwards |

<small>Type id: `meldstudio.recording`</small>

## Replay

Shows or hides the instant replay in Meld Studio.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Action** | Show plays the replay, Dismiss closes it. Options: Show, Dismiss. Starts as: `Show`. |

<small>Type id: `meldstudio.replay`</small>

## Send Meld command (advanced)

Sends Meld Studio one of its own commands by name. For advanced users.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Command** | The command name, like "meld.screenshot" or "meld.recordClip". Pick one from the suggestions. |

<small>Type id: `meldstudio.sendCommand`</small>

## Set browser layer URL

Makes a browser layer in Meld open a different web page.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Scene** | The scene the layer is in, as Meld shows it. Leave empty to look in the live scene first, then in all scenes. |
| **Layer** | The browser layer name as Meld shows it. Its id also works. |
| **URL** | The web address to open, like "https://example.com/alert". |

<small>Type id: `meldstudio.setBrowserLayerUrl`</small>

## Set effect enabled state

Turns an effect on a Meld layer on or off.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Scene** | The scene the layer is in, as Meld shows it. Leave empty to look in the live scene first, then in all scenes. |
| **Layer** | The layer name as Meld shows it, like "Webcam" (a layer is one item inside a scene). Its id also works. |
| **Effect** | The effect name as Meld shows it. Its id also works. |
| **State** | Enabled turns it on, Disabled turns it off, Toggle flips it. Options: Enabled, Disabled, Toggle. Starts as: `Toggle`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%meldStudio.effectEnabled%` | True if the effect is on afterwards |

<small>Type id: `meldstudio.setEffectState`</small>

## Set image/media layer source

Swaps the picture or video shown by an image or media layer.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Scene** | The scene the layer is in, as Meld shows it. Leave empty to look in the live scene first, then in all scenes. |
| **Layer** | The image or media layer name as Meld shows it. |
| **File** | The file on your computer, like "C:\Pictures\happy.png", or a web link starting with file://. |

<small>Type id: `meldstudio.setLayerSource`</small>

## Set item property

Changes one setting of a Meld scene, layer, effect or track. For advanced users who know the setting names.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Item** | The scene, layer, effect or track name as Meld shows it. Its id also works. |
| **Property** | Which setting to change, like visible, x, y, width, height, url or name. |
| **Value** | The new value, like true, 10 or some text. |

<small>Type id: `meldstudio.setProperty`</small>

## Set layer track muted state

Mutes or unmutes the sound of one layer, like a game capture.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Scene** | The scene the layer is in, as Meld shows it. Leave empty to look in the live scene first, then in all scenes. |
| **Layer** | The layer name as Meld shows it, like "Webcam" (a layer is one item inside a scene). Its id also works. |
| **State** | Muted silences it, Not Muted turns it back on, Toggle flips it. Options: Muted, Not Muted, Toggle. Starts as: `Toggle`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%meldStudio.trackMuted%` | True if the sound is muted afterwards |

<small>Type id: `meldstudio.setLayerTrackMuted`</small>

## Set layer visibility state

Shows or hides a layer (like a camera or image) in a Meld scene.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Scene** | The scene the layer is in, as Meld shows it. Leave empty to look in the live scene first, then in all scenes. |
| **Layer** | The layer name as Meld shows it, like "Webcam" (a layer is one item inside a scene). Its id also works. |
| **State** | Visible shows it, Hidden hides it, Toggle flips it. Options: Visible, Hidden, Toggle. Starts as: `Toggle`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%meldStudio.layerVisible%` | True if the layer is shown afterwards |

<small>Type id: `meldstudio.setLayerVisibility`</small>

## Set track gain

Sets the volume of an audio track.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Track** | The audio track: a global track name like "Microphone", or a layer name for that layer's sound. Its id also works. |
| **Gain (0-1)** | The volume from 0 (silent) to 1 (full), like 0.5 for half. Starts as: `1`. |

<small>Type id: `meldstudio.setTrackGain`</small>

## Set track monitoring state

Turns on or off listening to an audio track through your headphones (monitoring).

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Track** | The audio track: a global track name like "Microphone", or a layer name for that layer's sound. Its id also works. |
| **State** | Monitoring starts listening, Not Monitoring stops, Toggle flips it. Options: Monitoring, Not Monitoring, Toggle. Starts as: `Toggle`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%meldStudio.trackMonitoring%` | True if monitoring is on afterwards |

<small>Type id: `meldstudio.setTrackMonitoring`</small>

## Set track muted state

Mutes or unmutes an audio track, like your microphone.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Track** | The audio track: a global track name like "Microphone", or a layer name for that layer's sound. Its id also works. |
| **State** | Muted silences it, Not Muted turns it back on, Toggle flips it. Options: Muted, Not Muted, Toggle. Starts as: `Toggle`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%meldStudio.trackMuted%` | True if the track is muted afterwards |

<small>Type id: `meldstudio.setTrackMuted`</small>

## Show scene

Switches Meld Studio to another scene, live.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Scene** | The scene name as Meld Studio shows it, like "Just Chatting". Its id also works. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%meldStudio.sceneName%` | The scene that was shown |

<small>Type id: `meldstudio.showScene`</small>

## Show staged scene

Shows the scene you staged earlier in Meld Studio.

<small>Type id: `meldstudio.showStagedScene`</small>

## Stage scene

Puts a scene in the "up next" spot in Meld, so you can show it later with "Show staged scene". Vertical scenes cannot be staged.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Scene** | The scene name as Meld Studio shows it, like "Just Chatting". Its id also works. |

<small>Type id: `meldstudio.stageScene`</small>

## Streaming

Starts or stops your stream in Meld Studio.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **State** | Start begins streaming, Stop ends it, Toggle does the opposite of what it is doing now. Options: Start, Stop, Toggle. Starts as: `Toggle`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%meldStudio.isStreaming%` | True if Meld is streaming afterwards |

<small>Type id: `meldstudio.streaming`</small>

## Take screenshot

Takes a screenshot in Meld Studio. Meld saves the picture itself.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Orientation** | Horizontal is the normal wide picture, Vertical is the tall (phone) one. Options: Horizontal, Vertical. Starts as: `Horizontal`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%screenshotSuccess%` | True if Meld took the screenshot |

<small>Type id: `meldstudio.takeScreenshot`</small>

## Take vertical screenshot

Takes a tall (phone-shaped) screenshot in Meld Studio.

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%screenshotSuccess%` | True if Meld took the screenshot |

<small>Type id: `meldstudio.takeVerticalScreenshot`</small>

## Toggle virtual camera

Turns the Meld Studio virtual camera on if it is off, and off if it is on.

<small>Type id: `meldstudio.toggleVirtualCamera`</small>

## Widget event

Presses a button on a Meld widget, like firing confetti, resetting a countdown or adding time to a subathon timer.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Event** | The widget event name, like "CONFETTIPOP_TRIGGER" or "COUNTDOWN_RESET". Pick one from the suggestions. Starts as: `CONFETTIPOP_TRIGGER`. |
| **Amount (seconds)** | Only for SUBATHONTIMER_ADDTIME: how many seconds to add. |

<small>Type id: `meldstudio.widgetEvent`</small>
